models.notes: Reference baseline. Establishes that a model has learned anything at all.
National Grid ESO's published forecast, recorded at the horizon we received it. Not built here and not competing — it is the benchmark, and this is the only place it can be compared like for like.

Gradient boosting on 39 point-in-time features, no ESO input - the fair competitor. Out-of-sample MASE 0.46 to 0.55 against a best baseline of 1.03 to 1.38. Issued as a challenger; promotion is decided only by the pre-registered rule.
M5 opening champion. A baseline on purpose: the milestone's deliverable is the loop, and a model whose behaviour is fully understood makes the first live scores interpretable.

payload.note: Every promotion evaluation is recorded, including those that did not promote. A registry holding only successful promotions is evidence that failures went unrecorded, not that none occurred.
